facts.fact: Lucy 开口把 Catullus 诗的第一行译成「Delicious sparrow」，随即被全班倒抽一口气打断
Phil 当场纠正：Deliciae 跟 meae puellae 一致而不是 passer，正确译法是「My delicious, sweet, darling girlfriend」
facts.anchor: Deliciae agrees with meae puellae, not passer

facts.fact: 初中部（junior forms，前三年）拉丁文是必修课，按三十年前的旧教材灌语法和词汇
facts.anchor: had Latin as a compulsory subject

facts.fact: 中间组是四、五年级女生，十四到十六岁，在为 GCSE 学拉丁文
facts.anchor: the fourth and fifth years, aged between fourteen and sixteen

facts.fact: 教室后排那个有威势的女孩叫 Margot Hamilton，黑发粗辫、眼睛像磨亮的黑石
facts.anchor: Margot Hamilton, that was her name.

facts.fact: Margot 说 Miss Bredon 讲过校长会确保人人通过 GCSE
facts.anchor: Miss Bredon said so,’ Margot answered sullenly.

facts.fact: 事务长说 Margot 因在原校试图组建工会并罢工而被开除，理由归结为不服管教
facts.anchor: when Margot tried to form a union and go on strike

facts.fact: 校长在饭厅引用创办人的话，说这是给想塑造自己人生的女人待的地方
facts.anchor: this is a place for women who want to shape their own lives
